IELTS
Views:
The International English Language Testing System (IELTS) test measures ability to communicate in English across
all four language skills – listening, reading, writing, and speaking – for people who intend to study or work where English
is the language of communication.
IELTS is accepted as evidence of
English language proficiency for the purpose of admission.
All IELTS bookings are made through the IELTS booking system.
